transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you all know, forklift battery B-14 overheated while charging at Dock 2, producing smoke but no visible flame. Dock 2 remains closed until I authorize a controlled reopening with the required safety controls in place. In the meantime, the warehouse must continue processing outbound orders from the other docks. Per our incident-response routine, I need each of you — maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing — to report your current findings to me before I can authorize reopening. Let's go around the room. Who wants to start?
